import numpy as np, torch, model
net=model.load(); neg=model.negatives()
W=torch.tensor(np.load('contrast_c0_blocks.1_k12.npy'),dtype=torch.float32); b=1.0297
def dec(xi,c,delta=None,klo=0,khi=0,thr=0.0,lab=False):
    x=torch.tensor(xi,dtype=torch.float32); c=torch.tensor(c,dtype=torch.float32)
    L=None
    with torch.no_grad():
        for k in range(20):
            t=torch.full((x.shape[0],),1-k/20)
            v,a=net.velocity(x,t,c,("blocks.1",),count=False)
            s=a['blocks.1']@W+b
            if k==16: L=(s>0).numpy()
            if delta is not None and klo<=k<khi:
                v=v+(s>thr).float()[:,None]*torch.tensor(delta)
            x=x-v/20
    return (x.numpy(),L) if lab else x.numpy()
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
N=256; rows=[0,1,2]
XI={i:rng.standard_normal((N,2)).astype(np.float32) for i in rows}
xiD=rng.standard_normal((4096,2)).astype(np.float32); cD=rng.random(4096).astype(np.float32)
baseD,lab=dec(xiD,cD,lab=True)
print('label share',lab.mean())
keep=baseD[~lab]; ck=cD[~lab]
def between(a,c):
    # distance to nearest kept base action with |dc|<0.03
    out=[]
    for ai,ci in zip(a,c):
        m=np.abs(ck-ci)<0.03
        out.append(np.min(np.linalg.norm(keep[m]-ai,axis=1)))
    return np.array(out)
print('base between (kept) median', np.median(between(keep[:200],ck[:200])))
for klo,khi,ang,mag,thr in [(8,13,45,12,0),(8,13,180,12,0),(8,13,0,12,0),(6,12,0,6,0),(8,13,45,12,1),(8,13,180,12,1),(8,13,0,8,1),(8,14,0,8,1),(8,14,180,8,1)]:
    d=mag*np.array([np.cos(np.radians(ang)),np.sin(np.radians(ang))],np.float32)
    r=np.mean([np.mean(model.in_basin(i,dec(XI[i],np.full(N,neg['c'][i],np.float32),d,klo,khi,thr))) for i in rows])
    aD=dec(xiD,cD,d,klo,khi,thr)
    mv=np.linalg.norm(aD-baseD,axis=1)>0.3
    bt=between(aD[lab],cD[lab])
    print(klo,khi,ang,mag,thr,'r',round(r,3),'kept moved',round(mv[~lab].mean(),4),'target moved',round(mv[lab].mean(),3),'between>0.5',round((bt>0.5).mean(),3), 'med',round(np.median(bt),3))
